'''Mons Gratia''' is a mountain located west of the [[Quetzacalli Gorge]]. It lies along the "Pilgrim Path," a sacred route in [[Losanium]] that involves walking from the [[Teomat]] to the [[Proudspire]]. 

==Transportation==
Transport routes to the mountain include:
*[[Quetzal Transport System]] to Quetzacalli Gorge.

==Mountain features==

===NPCs===
*[[Pilgrim]]
*[[Mountain goat]]

===Monsters===
*[[Icefiend]] (on the mountain)
*[[Bandit (Varlamore)|Bandit]] (north-west of the mountain)
* [[White jaguar]] (west of the mountain)

===Hunter===
*[[Cerulean twitch]]
*[[Snowy knight]]
*[[Sapphire glacialis]]

==Trivia==
* "Mons Gratia" translates to "mountain grace" in Latin.
